title: Build a Profile Card
goal: Create a responsive profile card with avatar, name, bio, and social links.
steps: Create an HTML file with a container div for the card
Add an image (or emoji avatar), h2 name, and a short bio paragraph
Add two links (e.g. GitHub and Portfolio) using <a> tags
Style the card with CSS: centered, rounded corners, soft shadow
Use Flexbox to align content vertically
Make it look good on mobile (max-width + padding)
hint: Use border-radius, box-shadow, and display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center;
solution: A simple card uses a div.card with padding 1.5rem, border-radius 16px, and a max-width of 320px centered with margin: 0 auto.

title: Responsive Navbar
goal: Build a top navigation bar with logo on the left and links on the right.
steps: Create a <nav> with a logo span and a list of links
Set display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center
Style links with gap and remove default list styles
Add a background color and padding
On small screens, stack or hide links (optional media query)
hint: nav { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; }
solution: Flexbox on the nav with space-between places logo left and menu right. Use gap on the links container.

title: Fetch & Display Users
goal: Fetch data from a public API and render a list of users.
steps: Create a page with an empty <ul id="users"> and a Load button
On click, fetch('https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users')
Parse JSON with await res.json()
Map each user to an <li> showing name and email
Handle errors with try/catch and show a message if offline
hint: const res = await fetch(url); const data = await res.json();
solution:
Use async/await, check res.ok, then users.forEach(u => list.innerHTML += `
  • ${u.name} — ${u.email}
    • `).

title: Python Todo List (CLI)
goal: Build a command-line todo app that can add, list, and remove tasks.
steps: Create a list called todos = []
Print a menu: 1. Add  2. List  3. Remove  4. Quit
On Add: input a task and append to todos
On List: enumerate and print all tasks
On Remove: ask for index and pop that item
Loop until the user chooses Quit
hint: Use a while True loop and input() for the choice.
solution: while True: show menu; if choice == '1': todos.append(input('Task: ')); elif choice == '2': print list; elif choice == '4': break.

title: Hello API with Flask
goal: Create a tiny Flask API with GET /hello and POST /echo.
steps: pip install flask
Create app.py with Flask(__name__)
Add @app.get('/hello') returning JSON { message: 'Hello' }
Add @app.post('/echo') that returns the JSON body you sent
Run with python app.py and test in browser or with fetch
hint: from flask import Flask, jsonify, request
